statement: The client has a dynamic risk profile (risk class 4) with a 15-year investment horizon, a growth objective, and a solid capacity to bear losses given their income and wealth. The proposed portfolio is suitable for the client, as confirmed by the formal suitability assessment. It consists of the iShares Core MSCI World UCITS ETF USD Acc (SRI 4) weighted at 70% and the iShares € High Yield Corp Bond UCITS ETF EUR Dist (SRI 2) weighted at 30%, resulting in a weighted SRI well within the permitted limits. Furthermore, the client does not require liquidity within the next two years, matching the long-term nature of this allocation. Draft for advisor review and signature.
